notes: Birthdays for everyone. Every Zenless Zone Zero character now has their canon birthday (from the official agent calendar), and it's on the calendar. A few days before, close friends quietly plan something, whisper about it, or ask you to help keep it a surprise; on the day, people who know wish them happy birthday. Your phone reminds you the day before for people you know. 🧰 Tools → 🎂 Birthdays: see who's next, set your own birthday (people who trust you will remember it), and give a birthday to characters who don't have a canon one.
